name: obsidian-dark-reader-web-viewer
description: An Obsidian plugin that applies Dark Reader to the native Web viewer.

scripts.update:lint: npm install --save-dev eslint@latest eslint-plugin-obsidianmd@latest @eslint/js@latest globals@latest typescript-eslint@latest
